name: Jeeter | Berry White | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Berry White is an indica strain with an assortment of berry flavors like blueberry and strawberry complimented with extra citrus notes and light earthiness tones. With a relaxed yet alert high, Berry White is not only an iconic artist but the perfect strain for a midday break. Throw some Barry White on and light up a Berry White Jeeter for a cheat code on vibes.
